cards.title: Phoenix NCA Model Selection and Input Requirements
cards.claim: Phoenix NCA uses specific model IDs based on matrix and dose type: 200 (extravascular plasma), 201 (IV bolus plasma), 202 (constant infusion plasma), 210-212 (urine variants), and 220 (drug effect). Plasma models require 'time of last dose' and 'Tau' (for steady-state); infusion models also require 'length of infusion'. Urine models assume single-dose data.
conditions: Applicable when configuring NCA objects in Phoenix workflows.
Requires correct identification of dose type (extravascular, IV bolus, infusion) and matrix (plasma/blood vs. urine).
required_inputs: Tau (dose interval) for steady-state plasma models
Baseline effect and threshold (optional) for model 220
limitations: Does not specify the mathematical formulas for parameters (referenced as separate 'NCA parameter formulas' section).
Does not define default settings for lambda_z or AUC extrapolation.
Software-specific implementation; not a general PK theory reference.
cards.downstream_use: Guides correct object configuration for PK analysis. Ensures appropriate handling of infusion inputs and steady-state assumptions.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
